item.title: Iga Ninja Experience: Train Like a Shinobi — Guide
item.description: For anyone who has ever wanted to be a ninja, Iga is the place to actually try it. In the shinobi homeland, experience centres and the grounds around the Ninja Museum let visitors rent the black shozoku costume and learn the real skills under instruction: throwing shuriken stars at targets, handling a ninja sword, firing a blowgun (fukiya), and even scaling walls or crossing beams. Aimed squarely at families and the curious, the sessions are playful but rooted in the genuine techniques of the Iga-ryu tradition, turning a museum visit into an active, memorable half-day.
